messages:
chao: Heads-up — compact change window tonight 23:00–23:45 UTC. Plan: runtime v3.4.1 rollout, small API schema tweak (add optional field), console telemetry flag flip, and router header-split. Need cross-service interop check + explicit rollback triggers. Deploy-bot will run the canary steps.

alice: Thanks. Canary plan? which endpoints are in scope?

chao: Canary 5% for 15m -> 25% for 15m -> full. In-scope routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat; console-metrics route for telemetry only. Runtime change touches KV eviction header handling — must verify header parity across router and runtime.

ben: I'll pin runtime image to runtime:v3.4.1-build17 in the deploy manifest. Rollback threshold proposal: if p50 latency increases > 100ms vs baseline OR error rate delta +0.5% sustained for 10m -> rollback. Agree?

sam (sre-oncall): +1 for thresholds. I'll watch p50/p95 and 5xx. My quick rule: if 5xx > 0.3% for any 10m window OR console errors > 10/minute -> paging rollback. I'll be on-call for the window.

devops-bot: deploy scheduled by @chao at 2026-03-24T23:00:00Z. Canary job queued: canary-1779993210.

alice: Also request: console should keep the old telemetry path as a fallback for 10m after flag flip. If telemetry backlog spikes, flip back. Add a 2-minute hold before header-split on router so KV caches warm.

chao: Noted. Rollback procedure (short): 1) deploy-bot revert runtime image to runtime:v3.4.0, 2) API schema revert to previous contract (schema@2026-03-20), 3) router remove header-split flag, 4) console flip telemetry flag off. Who owns manual rollback run?

ben: I'll own the runtime image revert and confirm health checks. I have a quick kubectl command ready:

```
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/runtime runtime=registry.redwood/runtime:v3.4.0 && kubectl rollout status deploy/runtime -w
```

alice: Console flag name is `telemetry.v2.enable`. I'll add canary toggle in the console-config and preseed the old endpoint under `telemetry.v2.fallback_path`.

liz: I'll take release notes. I'll open a PR now and include the canary matrix, rollback criteria, and the ops checklist. Draft PR: https://git.redwood/release-notes/pull/452 — please add any bullets.

chao: Preflight checklist before start: 
1) snapshot KV metadata (s3://backups/kv/1779993210)
2) quick smoke load (1k reqs across /v1/generate) on staging
3) schema dry-run migrations applied and verified
4) pin manifests committed and deploybot plan validated
Please react with :white_check_mark: when each is done.

ben: Staging smoke done, no diffs in schema dry-run. Logs: `staging-smoke/ok`

alice: Console config updated with flag and fallback. Added hold gate before header-split. :white_check_mark:

sam (sre-oncall): Monitoring dashboards ready (latency/error/console-queue). Pager rotations set. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Canary started 2026-03-24T23:00:30Z — step 1: 5% traffic. Status: in-progress.

chao: I'll watch telemetry and kv eviction traces. If anything looks off call immediate abort.

alice: Noticing slight increase in telemetry queue size at +6m, but within expected. Holding.

sam (sre-oncall): p50 +40ms so far, p95 stable. 5xx still under 0.05%. Continue.

deploy-bot: Canary step 1 complete at 2026-03-24T23:15:35Z. Stepping to 25% for 15m.

ben: Confirming runtime health probes pass on all canary pods.

chao: If at any point p95 > 900ms or 5xx > 0.3% -> immediate rollback.

liz: Release notes PR updated with final numbers and links to runbook: https://go/runbooks/release-compact-window.

alice: Reminder: update post-deploy checklist to include KV compaction watch for 2 hours.

sam (sre-oncall): 25% hold 5m in: p95 +80ms but below 900ms; 5xx 0.07%. No paging.

deploy-bot: Canary finished. Traffic -> 100% at 2026-03-24T23:36:12Z. Rollout marked successful.

chao: Great work team. Post-mortem notes: keep the 2-minute header-hold as default for similar KV changes and validate telemetry fallback sooner in the next dry-run. I'll close the runbook ticket. :tada:
